text:
A: Hiya! Oh my God, Stacey, I loved your photo. The nails!
B: Aw, stop it! I said the same about yours, the gin bottle, I said she's my kind of person. I'm Stacey.
A: Joanne. And you've got Live Laugh Love up as well, I saw that.
B: No! Have you?
A: In the kitchen! Half out of shot, but it's there. We're the same person, love.
B: Ha, we are! Where are you?
A: Warrington. You're Nottingham way?
B: Sutton-in-Ashfield. I'm a care assistant. Liam said you were in sales?
A: Team leader, contact centre. Retentions. I talked one of the Liams out of cancelling his broadband apparently, before I'd even met him.
B: Ha! You must be good.
A: Best figures on the floor for years, I'm not going to lie. It's all reading people. You'd be good at it, you've got that chatty way.
B: Aw, people say that at work. The families always ask for me. I'm doing my senior carer stuff at the minute, so, you know, moving up.
A: Get you. You want to push for it, love. Nobody hands you anything, you've got to make sure the managers see what you're doing. I always make sure upstairs know when it's my team that's hit the numbers.
B: That's what I do! I make sure they hear about it. Ooh, I've got to tell you, I got a Michael Kors bag off Vinted last week. Thirty quid.
A: Shut up! I got one last month, forty. You beat me.
B: Ha, I know every trick on there, duck. You message them late at night, they're tired, they take anything.
A: Oh, that's good, I'm nicking that. Do you go out much?
B: Nights out with the girls from work. And shows. We did Mamma Mia in Nottingham, it were brilliant, I cried at the end.
A: I've seen Mamma Mia twice! At the Palace in Manchester. Then a gin the size of a goldfish bowl after.
B: Pink gin, me. Where do you go on holiday?
A: Tenerife, Turkey. And I did Dubai for my forty-fifth. Rooftop pool, the lot. I chatted up the rep and got us moved to a sea view.
B: Oh my God, I'm dying to do Dubai. Just to say I've been. Was it dear?
A: You've got to know where to look. I'll send you the site I use. You can pay it off monthly, it's easy, honestly.
B: Oh, we do that already, our Tenerife's on a deposit. And the dog. Kerry nearly fell off her chair when I told her my dog was on finance.
A: Ha! She's a bit careful, Kerry, isn't she? She told me off for doing my phone voice.
B: She didn't!
A: She did! First thing she said. I liked her, mind, she says what she thinks.
B: She does. I got a bit flustered, if I'm honest, I thought she was judging me.
A: Oh, don't let it get to you, love. Life's too short. You've worked for it, enjoy it. That's what I said when I got...
